figurative_meaning_en: Pretending not to know despite being aware
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চেতনে অবচেতন করে বলল যে কিছুই জানে না।
বন্ধুর ভুল দেখেও তুমি চেতনে অবচেতনের ভান করলে কেন?
example_sentences_in_english: He feigned ignorance and claimed he knew nothing about it.
Why did you pretend not to know about your friend's mistake even though you saw it?
note: This idiom metaphorically contrasts conscious awareness with feigned unconsciousness to describe deliberate denial of knowledge.
